title: Compensation and Benefits Analyst
summary: Makes sure employees are paid fairly and competitively by comparing salaries with the market, maintaining pay bands and running the yearly increment and bonus cycle. Sits in the HR rewards team and also manages benefits such as group health insurance.
dailyDuties: Benchmark roles against salary survey data
Update pay bands and check compa-ratios
Model the increment and bonus budget in Excel
Manage group health and accident insurance renewals
Prepare rewards and headcount cost reports
Answer pay questions from HR business partners

skills.expectation: Benchmark salaries against market surveys and run the annual increment cycle
Build and maintain pay bands and track compa-ratios
Evaluate and grade jobs within a job architecture
Model and calculate bonus and incentive payouts
Run benefits such as group health, accident and life insurance and their renewals
Report on rewards, headcount cost and attrition with clear dashboards
Build compensation models in Excel with pivot tables and lookups
Work with HR business partners, finance and leaders on budgets and approvals
Submit and use data from salary surveys such as Aon, Mercer or WTW
Check pay equity and internal parity across groups
Run compensation cycles in an HRMS
Know how PF, gratuity and wage rules affect salary structures
Publish rewards dashboards in Power BI

certifications.why: Shows advanced Excel skills used in compensation modelling
Covers total rewards as one of its HR knowledge areas.
